run.command: strata bench run --profile iq3_s --load-timeout 2400 --track custom --track-notes Locally tuned single-GPU Linux/HIP setup: calibrated --pool-workers 10, --vram-reserve-mib 1024 (setup default 700), opt-in env STRATA_HIPBLASLT_TUNING (30-row gfx1201/ROCm 10.1 table), STRATA_HIP_WMMA=1, STRATA_PF_FUSED=1, STRATA_GFX12_CHUNK=1 (prefill chunks 16384), STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=1, --spec 4 --spec-min-p 0.5, --mtp rt, Huihui refusal-direction control vector (project, layers 4-44), and the runner itself patched locally with the amd-smi hardware probe (PR #3519); engine 0.1.47 release binary, not a source build. --source-revision de4b8e4d43b917e7706784d8bb445c9af86a3540 --quantization IQ3_S (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-IQ3_S, 2 shards, 54817524224 + 28800138432 bytes) --custom-pack pack iq3_s built locally by tools/iq_pack.py from the two downloaded shards (dense.bin 1538035200 bytes, index.txt, native_experts.txt, tokenizer/) plus data/expert-profile.bin --background KDE Plasma Wayland compositor on the iGPU 0000:7c:00.0 (monitor on card2 HDMI); the R9700 0000:03:00.0 has no display output connected --background machine otherwise idle during the suite: no compiles, downloads or other GPU users --background model and packs on a WD_BLACK SN8100 4 TB NVMe (btrfs); PCIe gen5 x8, path 4/4, power limit 330 W --build-options engine 0.1.47 release binary from the Strata 0.2.2 install; ROCm 10.1; kernel 7.3.0-rc6-2-cachyos-rc; Strata repo commit 011c9e60 with the local bench_facts amd-smi probe (PR #3519) --optional-concurrency --output human

background_workloads: KDE Plasma Wayland compositor on the iGPU 0000:7c:00.0 (monitor on card2 HDMI); the R9700 0000:03:00.0 has no display output connected
machine otherwise idle during the suite: no compiles, downloads or other GPU users
model and packs on a WD_BLACK SN8100 4 TB NVMe (btrfs); PCIe gen5 x8, path 4/4, power limit 330 W

build_options: engine 0.1.47 release binary from the Strata 0.2.2 install; ROCm 10.1; kernel 7.3.0-rc6-2-cachyos-rc; Strata repo commit 011c9e60 with the local bench_facts amd-smi probe (PR #3519)

model.custom_pack: pack iq3_s built locally by tools/iq_pack.py from the two downloaded shards (dense.bin 1538035200 bytes, index.txt, native_experts.txt, tokenizer/) plus data/expert-profile.bin
